Its first part reached cinemas at Diwali 2026 and is in theatres now
hook_line: A. R. RAHMAN SPENT THREE YEARS ON 'RAMAYANA' MUSIC, TURNED DOWN 10–12 FILMS

hook_stat.sub: Spent by A. R. Rahman on the music of Nitesh Tiwari's two-part 'Ramayana'

news_summary: A. R. Rahman told a press conference at the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Panaji that he has spent nearly three years on the music of Nitesh Tiwari's two-part 'Ramayana', turned down 10–12 film projects to stay focused on it, and is composing the score with Hans Zimmer.
payoff: Three years of music work went into 'Ramayana', most of it before a frame reached the screen.

stats.label: Turned down by Rahman so he could stay focused on 'Ramayana'
Some pieces went through — including the 'Ravana Tandav', worked on in different languages
